callout.title: Get Started
callout.text: Type "Start" in the input above to begin answering questions about your business. I'll guide you through a series of questions to help us understand your product, market, and business model.

product.name: What is the name of your product?
product.description: Can you describe your product in detail?
product.category: What category does your product belong to?
product.stage: What stage is your product currently in? (e.g., MVP, Beta, Launched)

market.geography: What geographic markets are you targeting?
market.alternatives: What are the main alternatives or competitors to your product? (comma-separated)

customer.role: What is the role of your ideal customer? (e.g., CTO, Marketing Manager)
customer.companyStage: What stage are your target customer companies typically in?
customer.teamSize: What team size do your target customers typically have?

problem.mainPain: What is the main pain point your product solves?
problem.frequency: How often do customers experience this problem?
problem.currentSolution: What solutions are customers currently using to address this problem?

solution.coreValue: What is the core value proposition of your solution?
solution.differentiator: What makes your solution different from alternatives?

distribution.knownChannels: What distribution channels are you aware of or considering? (comma-separated)
distribution.preferredChannel: What is your preferred distribution channel?

pricing.model: What pricing model are you using or planning to use?
pricing.expectedPrice: What is your expected price point?

traction.users: How many users do you currently have?
traction.signals: What traction signals or metrics are you tracking?
